svg.title: Birdy — LIVE · GOOGLE PLAY + APP STORE
svg.desc: An app for bird breeders to manage their aviary — birds, pairs, genetics and pedigree. Built, shipped and run by me, from design to store billing. A desktop version that works offline and syncs on its own. Security-tested against my own production backend.
